column1: # Word data for jp.py. Columns: kind, key, value, note.
#   r  fixed reading, applied when MeCab splits the word off as a whole token
#   s  text replaced before MeCab, for words it splits and then misreads
#   j  katakana compound written solid, for pairs MeCab splits (value column empty)
# Every entry is measured net-positive against human romaji on a lyric corpus.
# Order matters for s rows: earlier rows run first (咽返る before 咽返).
